detailed_descriptions.en: In Soulmask: Shifting Sands , you will survival in a unique world where ancient Egyptian myths meet alien technology. Unlock anti-gravity engineering to build and command your own Solar Barge. Equip your airship with customizable modules and powerful weapons to battle colossal beings rising from the shifting sands, and forge a survival legend shaped entirely by your choices. Soulmask: Shifting Sands features a world as large as the base game, with 500+ hours of content. Even if you’re new to Soulmask, you can begin your journey directly in Shifting Sands. Your vessel, your fortress, your home. Fly, battle, and build in a whole new way Every ship supports custom building—install a light Anti-Gravity Engine to soar into the skies, or equip a small sand skid to skim across desert dunes. Rig your vessel with a control deck, gangway, and speed sail, or mount various ballistas and cannons to transform your ship into a mobile armored fortress! Bring your tribesmen aboard! They will live and work on the ship, establishing a fully functional aerial production and construction base. An Unlimited Build Mode lets you create without material restrictions, unlocking complete freedom in ship design. With the new Blueprint System , players can easily share and download their dream vessels. Put on the Mask and Walk with Gods—each mask holds a divine ability waiting to be unleashed. Featuring several new masks inspired by ancient Egyptian deities. Don the mask to unlock the untapped power of the gods. Horus Mask – Celestial Wings Available from the start. Become the avatar of the sky god, granting free flight and devastating diving attack abilities. Anubis Mask – Doomsday Judgment Become the Guardian of the underworld. Wither your foes, balance status effects, and resurrect fallen enemies nearby to join your combat force. Sobek Mask – Abyss Overlord Embody the crocodile god, summoning water currents for guarding yourself and trapping enemies in its strong tides. Amun-Ra Mask – Glorious Hymn Incarnate as the sun god, wielding solar rays and blazing flames to burn your enemies to ashes. New Map: A familiar yet mind-bending Anti-Gravity Egyptian World. Braving dynamic day-night cycles and harsh survival challenges, immerse yourself in the legendary landscapes of Egypt! Discover hidden "surreal" sci-fi wonders: floating "islands", a pyramid inverted in the sky, and other mind-bending spectacles waiting to be explored!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In Soulmask: Shifting Sands, you will survival in a unique world where ancient Egyptian myths meet alien technology. Unlock anti-gravity engineering to build and command your own Solar Barge.

Equip your airship with customizable modules and powerful weapons to battle colossal beings rising from the shifting sands, and forge a survival legend shaped entirely by your choices.

Soulmask: Shifting Sands features a world as large as the base game, with 500+ hours of content. Even if you’re new to Soulmask, you can begin your journey directly in Shifting Sands.

Your vessel, your fortress, your home. Fly, battle, and build in a whole new way

  • Every ship supports custom building—install a light Anti-Gravity Engine to soar into the skies, or equip a small sand skid to skim across desert dunes. Rig your vessel with a control deck, gangway, and speed sail, or mount various ballistas and cannons to transform your ship into a mobile armored fortress!

  • Bring your tribesmen aboard! They will live and work on the ship, establishing a fully functional aerial production and construction base.

  • An Unlimited Build Mode lets you create without material restrictions, unlocking complete freedom in ship design.

  • With the new Blueprint System, players can easily share and download their dream vessels.

Put on the Mask and Walk with Gods—each mask holds a divine ability waiting to be unleashed.

Featuring several new masks inspired by ancient Egyptian deities. Don the mask to unlock the untapped power of the gods.

Horus Mask – Celestial Wings

  • Available from the start. Become the avatar of the sky god, granting free flight and devastating diving attack abilities.

Anubis Mask – Doomsday Judgment

  • Become the Guardian of the underworld. Wither your foes, balance status effects, and resurrect fallen enemies nearby to join your combat force.

Sobek Mask – Abyss Overlord

  • Embody the crocodile god, summoning water currents for guarding yourself and trapping enemies in its strong tides.

Amun-Ra Mask – Glorious Hymn

  • Incarnate as the sun god, wielding solar rays and blazing flames to burn your enemies to ashes.

New Map: A familiar yet mind-bending Anti-Gravity Egyptian World.

Braving dynamic day-night cycles and harsh survival challenges, immerse yourself in the legendary landscapes of Egypt! Discover hidden "surreal" sci-fi wonders: floating "islands", a pyramid inverted in the sky, and other mind-bending spectacles waiting to be explored!
